If you are travelling with your own electric wheelchair, please inform your respective airline in advance so they can coordinate the required process and approvals with BLR Airport. For wheelchair assistance, the request should be placed at the time of booking or at least 48 hours before travel.

**Wheelchair Assistance**

> **Wheelchair Assistance**
> **Zone:** Special Assistance - Wheelchair Assistance
> Passengers requiring wheelchair assistance at BLR Airport must place a request with the respective airlines at the time of booking tickets or 48 hours prior to their travel. Passengers using personal wheelchairs are requested to contact the respective airlines in advance regarding the processes and approvals. There are dedicated zones reserved for passenger drop-off and pick-up when availing wheelchair assistance at BLR Airport. Please speak to the on-ground team for assistance.
> **Reference:** [Click here for more details](https://www.bengaluruairport.com/travellers/services/special-assistance/wheelchair-assistance)

> **Mobility Assist**
> **Zone:** Special Assistance - Mobility Assist
> Seamless Mobility Support for People with Disabilities. This service helps make boarding and deplaning comfortable and dignified, with smooth transfers and coordinated support in partnership with your airline. Please inform your airline at least 24 hours prior to departure.
> **Reference:** [Click here for more details](https://www.bengaluruairport.com/travellers/services/special-assistance/mobility-assist)

If you would like, I can also help you with the nearest wheelchair assistance counter or the PRM drop-off locations in T1 or T2."
